content.title: What restaurants are open on Easter Sunday? What about stores?
content.text: April 5, 2026, 6:02 a.m. MTIf your plans involve shopping for last-minute Easter baskets or confetti-filled eggs on Easter Sunday, some stores will be closed.Easter Sunday is April 5, and while some will celebrate by attending mass and participating in Easter egg hunts, you might want to stop by a store or head out to eat after the holiday festivities. Some retail and grocery chains, like Walmart, Whole Foods and Walgreens, are open on the holiday, but others, like Sam's Club, Target and Costco, will be closed.Meanwhile, if you're hungry, fast-food restaurants like McDonald's and Whataburger will be open.Here's what to know about what's open and closed on Easter Sunday.When is Easter 2026?This year, Easter falls on Sunday, April 5.Is Walmart open on Easter?Yes, Walmart stores will be open regular hours on Easter, according to the company's website. Most Walmart stores are open from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. daily.Is Costco open on Easter?No, Costco warehouses will be closed on Easter, according to the company's website.Is Sam's Club open on Easter?No, Sam's Club warehouses will be closed on Easter Sunday, according to the company's website.Is Whole Foods open on Easter?According to the company's website, most Whole Foods stores will be open on Easter, but many will close earlier than usual.Customers can use the company's store locator tool to confirm their local store's hours.Is Walgreens open on Easter?Yes, most Walgreens stores will be open on Easter, though hours may vary at your local store. Check the hours at your nearest store.Is CVS open on Easter?CVS will be open on Easter, although some stores may have reduced hours on the holiday.Is Trader Joe's open on Easter?Yes, Trader Joe's is open regular hours on Sunday, April 5.Is Home Depot open on Easter?Home Depot will open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Easter Sunday, according to its website.Is Lowes open on Easter?No, Lowes will be closed on Easter Sunday.Is Macy's open on Easter?No, Macy's stores will be closed on Easter Sunday. Is Chili's open on Easter?Most Chili's will be open on Easter, but some may close early. It's best to check with your closest location.Is McDonald's open on Easter?Hours vary by location, but most McDonald's locations in the United States are open on holidays.Is Starbucks open on Easter?Starbucks store hours vary by location. You can find hours for a specific store using the Starbucks app.Is Chick-fil-A open on Easter?Easter is celebrated on a Sunday, meaning Chick-fil-A will be closed.Is Chipotle open on Easter?Chipotle restaurants will be closed on Easter.Is Wendy's open on Easter?Most Wendy's locations will be open on Easter, but hours vary by location. It's best to check with your local restaurant for their specific holiday hours.Is Burger King open on Easter?Burger King hours vary by location, so customers are encouraged to confirm through the Burger King app.Is Cracker Barrel open on Easter?Yes, Cracker Barrel restaurants will be open regular hours on Easter.Is Raising Cane's open on Easter?No, Raising Cane's locations will be closed on Sunday, April 5.Is Taco Bell open on Easter?Hours of operation may vary by location, so Taco Bell customers are encouraged to check with their local restaurant regarding their holiday hours.Is IHOP open on Easter?IHOP restaurants will be open on April 5. Hours vary by location, so check with your local restaurant for their specific hours.Is Krispy Kreme open on Easter?Krispy Kreme shops will be open their regular hours on Sunday, April 5.Is Whataburger open on Easter?Yes, Whataburger restaurants will be open regular hours on Easter Sunday.Natassia Paloma may be reached at npaloma@gannett.com, @NatassiaPaloma on x; natassia_paloma on Instagram, and Natassia Paloma Thompson on Facebook.
